description: This file provides functions to read content from memory files, with support for path resolution, access control, and partial content retrieval, specifically for files with '.md' extension. It also includes a function to read memory files associated with an agent configuration.

methods.name: readMemoryFile
methods.description: Reads a memory file from a specified workspace, with optional range of lines, handling path validation and file existence checks.

methods.name: readAgentMemoryFile
methods.description: Reads a memory file associated with a specific agent configuration, resolving paths and settings accordingly.
